resolution.title: Attach the curated JoinMap result
resolution.detail: JoinMap 4.1 is licensed Windows software and the paper includes manual curation. Run that step externally, then attach the exported linkage map here.

recipes.title: Attach a curated JoinMap export
recipes.summary: Keep the licensed, manually curated linkage-map step external and attach its reviewed output.
steps: Run the reported JoinMap workflow in the licensed desktop application.
Review and curate the linkage groups using the study protocol.
Export the final linkage map and attach it to this checkpoint.
